chapter: Precision, the union and learning to read
title: Page's advice and the need to read music
summary: Crawford says Page encouraged him to read, and reading was essential for his twenty Broadway musicals.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Tell me this, concerning Page. What kind of advice would he give you, do you recall any of that?
Yeah, just -- the man would just talk in general about music-wise, musicianship. (Yes). He had good experience.
Did he encourage you to learn how to read, those kind of things?
Oh, yeah. Got to read, or else I wouldn't have been playing those 20 -- over 20 Broadway musicals. I'm very proud of that, had to read.
